message.content: {"note_claim": "Under UNCLOS Article 110(1)(d), warships may board vessels suspected of being stateless on the high seas.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "a warship which encounters on the high seas a foreign ship... is not justified in boarding it unless there is reasonable ground for suspecting that:...
